title: cheilanthes tricholepifera

This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cheilanthes tricholepifera are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate immune responses, and exhibit antiproliferative effects, making it a potential candidate for the treatment of cancer and other diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been identified as flavonoids, terpenoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
